cues.en: Hello my friends, and welcome to this new hands-on tutorial on feature engineering with SageMaker.
cues.zh: 朋友們好，歡迎來到使用 SageMaker 做特徵工程的新實作。

cues.en: So we are back into Canvas because we're gonna work again on our data wrangler flow that we created before in order to data wrangle our dataset.
cues.zh: 回到 Canvas，再使用之前建立、用來整理資料集的 Data Wrangler 流程。

cues.en: So let's go back into this data flow.
cues.zh: 進入這個資料流程。

cues.en: Here it is.
cues.zh: 就在這裡。

cues.en: Remember we had the data.csv as the source.
cues.zh: 記得來源是 Data.csv。

cues.en: Then remember first we one hot encoded the country column.
cues.zh: 先對 Country 獨熱編碼。

cues.en: Then we handled the missing data for both the salary and age columns.
cues.zh: 再處理 Salary 與 Age 的缺失資料。

cues.en: And then we label encoded the purchase column, which is a target column, all right?
cues.zh: 接著對目標欄 Purchased 做標籤編碼。

cues.en: And so now I'm going to show you how we can add another transformation, which will be exactly feature scaling.
cues.zh: 現在展示如何再加入轉換，也就是特徵縮放。

cues.en: And I'm even going to show you dimensionality reduction because that's part of feature engineering.
cues.zh: 甚至會展示降維，因為也是特徵工程的一部分。

cues.en: So here we go.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: Let's click the plus button here to add another transformation, and then we click Add transform.
cues.zh: 按加號，再按 Add transform，加入另一項轉換。

cues.en: Okay, so that's our pre-process dataset.
cues.zh: 這是前處理後資料集。

cues.en: Remember after all these five transformations, or more precisely five steps and three transformations here.
cues.zh: 記得做了五個轉換，更確切說，是五個步驟、三個轉換。

cues.en: And so let's add a new transform to do feature scaling so that all our features are on the same scale, okay?
cues.zh: 再加新轉換做特徵縮放，讓全部特徵在相同尺度。

cues.en: That's the point here.
cues.zh: 這就是重點。

cues.en: And so according to you, let's try to find this together.
cues.zh: 一起找找看。

cues.en: What would be feature scaling here among all the transformations, among all the transforms?
cues.zh: 全部轉換裡，哪個是特徵縮放？

cues.en: Well, not that obvious, to find it, you know, especially the first time, it's actually this one, process numeric, transform numeric values to improve machine learning model performance.
cues.zh: 第一次不太容易找，其實是 Process numeric，轉換數值以改善機器學習模型效能。

cues.en: Indeed, that's exactly the purpose of feature scaling.
cues.zh: 正是特徵縮放的目的。

cues.en: All right, so now we recognize feature scaling better because indeed it transform.
cues.zh: 現在比較認得了，在 Transform 裡，

cues.en: We see scale values, that's exactly what we wanna do.
cues.zh: 看到 Scale values，就是要做的。

cues.en: We wanna scale the feature's values, okay?
cues.zh: 縮放特徵值。

cues.en: So scale values here.
cues.zh: 選 Scale values。

cues.en: And then you recognize here standard scaler, which is the scaler use for standardization as opposed to normalization.
cues.zh: 這裡的 Standard scaler，是標準化的縮放器，不同於正規化。

cues.en: And if we click the drop down here, well, we will also find normalization, which is exactly min-max scaler.
cues.zh: 按下拉選單，也會找到正規化，也就是 Min-max scaler。

cues.en: Okay, so what do you wanna do?
cues.zh: 你想做哪個？

cues.en: Standardization or normalization?
cues.zh: 標準化還是正規化？

cues.en: We even have other scalers like the robust scaler or the max absolute scaler.
cues.zh: 也有其他選項，例如 Robust scaler、Max absolute scaler。

cues.en: Well, let's do standardization.
cues.zh: 做標準化。

cues.en: That's the most commonly used scaler, and it'll definitely bring good results.
cues.zh: 最常用，而且能帶來好結果。

cues.en: And now input columns.
cues.zh: 現在是 Input columns。

cues.en: Well, definitely no need to scale these three one hot encoded columns because they have value zeros and ones, but we can definitely scale these two
cues.zh: 這三個獨熱編碼欄位只有 0、1，不需要縮放，但這兩個可以縮放，

cues.en: because they're definitely not on the same scale.
cues.zh: 因為它們的尺度明顯不同。

cues.en: So let's put these two on the same scale according to standardization, all right?
cues.zh: 透過標準化，讓這兩個在相同尺度。

cues.en: And so here among the columns, we simply need to select these two, long age and salary.
cues.zh: 欄位裡只需選 Age 與 Salary。

cues.en: Perfect.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: We can click out of it.
cues.zh: 點選外面。

cues.en: Let's check advanced.
cues.zh: 檢查 Advanced。

cues.en: No need to do anything here, that's fine.
cues.zh: 這裡不需處理，沒問題。

cues.en: We can click Add.
cues.zh: 按 Add。

cues.en: This is adding the features, getting transformation with standardization.
cues.zh: 正在加入標準化的特徵縮放轉換。

cues.en: And there you go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: Now our age and salary features are in the same scale.
cues.zh: 現在 Age 與 Salary 在相同尺度。

cues.en: Perfect.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: So that will improve the performance of your future machinery model, which by the way, we will build in part two.
cues.zh: 這會改善之後機器學習模型的表現，順帶一提，第二部分會建立模型。

cues.en: Okay, good.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And now finally, I also wanted to show you dimensionality reduction because that's part of feature engineering.
cues.zh: 最後也想展示降維，因為屬於特徵工程。

cues.en: So let's click again, Add transform, and now it's much easier to find.
cues.zh: 再次按 Add transform，這次容易找得多。

cues.en: Here it is dimensionality reduction.
cues.zh: 就在這裡，Dimensionality reduction。

cues.en: First, you can choose the dimensionality reduction techniques such as PCA, LDA, or QDA.
cues.zh: 首先可以選降維技術，例如 PCA、LDA、QDA。

cues.en: Ah, no, actually there's only PCA.
cues.zh: 啊，不對，其實只有 PCA。

cues.en: So perfect, that's actually the most commonly used.
cues.zh: 很好，也是最常用的。

cues.en: Principle component analysis.
cues.zh: 主成分分析。

cues.en: Good.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Now input columns.
cues.zh: 現在 Input columns。

cues.en: Well, here I recommend to select all except the target one.
cues.zh: 建議除了目標欄，其餘全選。

cues.en: So we're gonna remove immediately purchased 'cause we basically wanna reduce the dimensionality of our features, okay?
cues.zh: 所以立即移除 Purchased，因為要降低特徵的維度。

cues.en: And then output format columns, yes, definitely.
cues.zh: Output format 選 Columns，沒錯。

cues.en: And advance, I guess here you'll be able to choose a number of principle components right here.
cues.zh: Advanced，我想這裡可以選主成分數量。

cues.en: There you go.
cues.zh: 就在這裡。

cues.en: So that you can choose actually the final dimension of your data set after applying dimensionality reduction.
cues.zh: 能選套用降維後，資料集最後的維度。

cues.en: So we're gonna keep the recommended number of principle component.
cues.zh: 保留建議的主成分數量。

cues.en: Let's not set one specifically.
cues.zh: 不另外指定。

cues.en: You will see that we'll end up with a relevant number of principle components.
cues.zh: 你會看到，最後會有合適數量的主成分。

cues.en: So no need to do anything here.
cues.zh: 這裡不用做其他修改。

cues.en: Let's click Add, and you will see we will end up with a brand new dataset with different features, which are the principle components.
cues.zh: 按 Add，就會得到全新資料集，有不同特徵，也就是主成分。

cues.en: As you can see here, this is the first principle component, the second one, and the third one.
cues.zh: 這是第一主成分、第二、第三。

cues.en: And it's completely normal.
cues.zh: 非常正常。

cues.en: If you don't recognize anything, it's because your dataset was completely transformed.
cues.zh: 如果完全認不出原資料，是因為資料集已完全轉換。

cues.en: All right, and indeed we have less features in our dataset.
cues.zh: 特徵確實更少了。

cues.en: Remember we used to have, salary, age, and then the three, one hot encoded country variables.
cues.zh: 記得原本有 Salary、Age，以及三個獨熱編碼 Country 變數。

cues.en: We basically had five features, and now we end up with three, okay?
cues.zh: 基本上原有五個特徵，現在剩三個。

cues.en: So that's it.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: That's it for this tutorial on feature engineering with SageMaker.
cues.zh: 這堂 SageMaker 特徵工程實作到此。

cues.en: I look forward to seeing you in the next hands-on tutorial, which will be the section cleanup tutorial.
cues.zh: 期待下一堂實作，也就是本節資源清理。

cues.en: So make absolutely sure to do this tutorial because I don't want you to get charged by SageMaker.
cues.zh: 一定要做，因為我不希望你持續被 SageMaker 計費。
